bio.text: Jo Anne Simon is the Assembly Member for the 52nd Assembly District in Brooklyn.
She grew up in Yonkers, graduated from Iona College, earned a master's degree in education of the deaf from Gallaudet University, and earned a law degree from Fordham University School of Law.
She founded a disability civil rights law firm in Downtown Brooklyn, is an adjunct assistant professor of law at Fordham, and has lived in Brooklyn since 1981.
She was elected female District Leader and State Committeewoman for the 52nd Assembly District in 2004.
